::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Assessment rubric for the challenges (delete it before submitting)

| Criterion | Weight | Excellent | Acceptable | Insufficient |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Searching and selecting sources** | 25% | Documented, reproducible strategy; relevant and varied sources | Simple strategy; suitable sources | No strategy or poorly relevant sources |
| **Critical evaluation** | 25% | Each source is evaluated with explicit criteria and the claims are checked | Generic evaluation | Sources accepted without evaluation |
| **Ethical use and citation** | 20% | All borrowed ideas cited; complete references in a consistent style | Minor citation errors | Borrowed ideas not cited or incomplete references |
| **Argumentation** | 20% | Conclusions supported by the sources; limitations acknowledged | Reasonable conclusions | Unsupported conclusions |
| **Presentation** | 10% | Clear, well-organised text without typos | Some formal errors | Disorganised |
:::
